subjectTemplate: Vietnam Basalt & Granite – Direct Quarry & Factory Supplier
bodyTemplate:
Dear {{company_name}} team,

I’m {{sender_name}}, {{sender_title}}. We have our own quarry and factory in Vietnam, supplying natural basalt (bluestone) and granite directly.

Our main products:
- Bluestone saw cut pavers and tiles: 600x1200, 600x900, 400x600, 300x600, in 20/30/50 mm, with 5 finishes
- Cobbles, tumbled pavers, crazy paving and stepping stones
- Kerbs, pool coping and wall cladding
- Granite (yellow and gray) and pebbles

I’ve attached our 2026 catalogue and photos. Are you currently looking for a supplier? If so, please send me the destination port, the products you need and the max cargo weight, and I’ll prepare a quotation right away.

We look forward to a long-term cooperation with you.

WhatsApp: {{sender_phone}}

Best regards,
{{sender_name}}
{{sender_title}}
